note: Mortimer and Randolph's Heritage Club

dish.make_ahead: Assemble up to 1 day ahead, bake before serving

steps.text: Push an almond into each prune.
Wrap each in half a rasher of bacon and secure with a toothpick.
Bake at 200C until the bacon is crisp.
Serve warm.

note: catch them first, they will escape

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours, assemble just before serving

steps.text: Chop the lobster and fold with mayonnaise, lemon juice, celery and chives.
Cut 16 rounds from the buttered brioche slices.
Toast the rounds.
Pile the lobster on top.

note: for the bench by the bridge at dawn

steps.text: Whip the cream cheese with the milk until light.
Split and toast the bagels.
Spread thickly, then layer with salmon, capers, onion and dill.
Cut in half and serve on a board.

note: the party where Joe and Kathleen meet face to face and argue

steps.text: Cut the cucumbers into 1.5cm rounds and pat dry.
Beat the cream cheese with the chopped dill and lemon zest.
Pipe or spoon onto each round.
Top with salmon, capers, a dill sprig and pepper.

note: Sam's houseboat on the lake

dish.make_ahead: Dip up to 2 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Flake the salmon into the cream cheese and crème fraîche.
Add lemon juice, dill, capers and horseradish and mix.
Slice the bagels thin and brush with oil.
Bake at 180C into crisp chips.
Serve the chips with the dip.

note: Hand-chopped raw beef with shallot, capers, cornichons and egg yolk

dish.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours, keep well chilled

steps.text: Chop the chilled eye fillet very finely by hand with a sharp knife.
Mix with the diced shallot, capers, chopped cornichons, Dijon, Worcestershire and egg yolk. Season well.
Toast the brioche slices and serve alongside.

note: Fresh oysters on crushed ice, red wine vinegar and shallot dressing, lemon

steps.text: Shuck the oysters (or ask the fishmonger to) and lay them on crushed ice.
Mix the vinegar with the finely diced shallot and cracked pepper.
Cut the lemon into wedges and serve with the dressing on the side.

note: Rye squares with smoked salmon, lemon crème fraîche and dill

steps.text: Butter the rye slices and cut each into small squares.
Whip the creme fraiche with the lemon zest until it holds a soft peak.
Top each square with smoked salmon, a small dot of creme fraiche, a dill sprig and cracked pepper.

note: Warm buckwheat blini, crème fraîche, salmon roe and snipped chives

steps.text: Warm the blini on a tray in a 180C oven.
Top each with a teaspoon of creme fraiche, a little roe and snipped chives.
Serve straight away on a silver tray if you have one.

note: Mini pizza rounds with sauce, mozzarella and a slice of pepperoni

steps.text: Heat the oven to 230C with a tray inside.
Roll out the dough on a floured bench and cut into rounds.
Spread each round with sauce, then add mozzarella and a slice of pepperoni.
Bake on the hot tray until the bases are crisp and the cheese bubbles.

note: Wang's family restaurant, before everything goes sideways

dish.make_ahead: Uncooked up to 1 day, keep chilled

ingredients.item: black vinegar and chilli oil, to dip

steps.text: Mix the pork with the chives, ginger, soy, Shaoxing and sesame oil.
Pleat spoonfuls into the gyoza wrappers.
Fry until the bottoms crisp.
Add the water and steam with the lid on.
Serve with vinegar and chilli oil.

note: late night in Chinatown

steps.text: Score the squid and cut into strips.
Toss in the starch with salt, white pepper and five spice.
Fry at 190C in batches until crisp.
Wok-toss with fried garlic, chilli and spring onion.

note: King prawns with garlic, chili and lemon, grilled hot on skewers

steps.text: Soak the skewers. Toss the prawns with crushed garlic, chopped chilli, zest of one lemon and the oil.
Thread onto skewers and marinate in the fridge.
Grill hot until just cooked, turning once.
Melt the butter with the lemon myrtle and brush over. Serve with lemon wedges.

note: Seasoned minced beef in gravy, shortcrust base and puff pastry lid

steps.text: Brown the mince with the diced onion, then add Worcestershire, tomato sauce and stock. Thicken with cornflour mixed with a little water.
Cool the filling completely.
Line patty tins with shortcrust, fill, and top with puff lids.
Bake at 200C until golden.
Slice the onions.
Grill the sausages slowly over medium heat, turning often, and fry the onions in oil until soft and golden at the same time.
Wrap each sausage in a slice of bread with onions and a squeeze of tomato sauce.

note: Creamy chicken and mushroom pastry cases, plus asparagus wrapped in prosciutto

steps.text: Bake the vol-au-vent cases until crisp.
Dice the chicken and mushrooms and fry in butter until browned.
Add the cream and thyme and reduce until thick, then fill the cases.
Blanch the asparagus and wrap each spear in half a slice of prosciutto.

note: Soft yeast dough buns filled with seasoned beef, onion and dill

steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast, warm milk, sugar and butter into a soft dough and knead briefly.
Cover and let the dough prove.
Fry the mince with the chopped onion and dill.
Cool the filling.
Cut the dough into rounds, fill, and seal.
Bake at 200C until golden.

note: Mini hot dogs glazed sticky with Dijon and honey

steps.text: Simmer the franks and drain.
Toss in a hot pan with the mustard and honey until sticky and glazed.
Spear each on a toothpick and serve hot.

note: Pork and veal meatballs in tomato sauce on small slider buns

steps.text: Mix the mince with the breadcrumbs, egg and parmesan and roll into balls.
Brown the meatballs in oil.
Simmer in the passata.
Put each in a slider bun with provolone and basil and grill until the cheese melts.

note: smoked salmon blini on silver trays

steps.text: Warm the blini on a tray at 180C.
Top each with crème fraîche and a curl of smoked salmon.
Finish with salmon roe and a dill sprig.
Pass around on a tray straight away.

note: Warm buttermilk biscuits with Dijon butter and thin sliced ham

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220C. Rub the cold butter into the flour and salt.
Stir in the buttermilk and pat out the dough thick. Cut into rounds.
Bake until risen and golden.
Split warm, spread with butter mixed with Dijon and fill with ham.

note: Crisp potato skins with cheddar and bacon, sour cream and chives

steps.text: Bake the potatoes at 200C until tender.
Cook the bacon until crisp and crumble it.
Halve the potatoes, scoop out most of the flesh and brush with butter.
Crisp the skins at 220C.
Fill with cheddar and bacon and bake until melted.
Top with sour cream and chives.
Cut the cheddar into slabs and fold the salami into quarters.
Lay them out on a chopping board with the saltine crackers and a small bowl of pickled jalapeños. Eat straight off the board.

note: Baked cream cheese and sour cream dip with crab and cheddar, crackers

steps.text: Heat the oven to 190C. Mix the cream cheese, sour cream, Worcestershire and a squeeze of lemon.
Fold in the crab and half the cheddar, spoon into a dish and top with the rest.
Bake until bubbling.
Serve with crackers.
Mix the salt and chilli powder on a plate. Rub the glass rims with lime and dip.
Fill the glasses with ice and add lime juice, tomato juice, hot sauce and Worcestershire.
Top with cold lager poured slowly, stir once and garnish with lime wedges.
Roast the macadamias at 170C and toss with salt while warm.
Slice the beef biltong thinly across the grain.
Pile on a board with the dried peaches and macadamias in little bowls.

note: Griddled franks in steamed buns with yellow mustard

steps.text: Simmer the franks in water, then griddle until blistered all over.
Steam the buns and finely chop the onion.
Fill with franks and top with mustard, relish and onion.

note: Pork, prawn and shiitake dumplings with ginger and soy

steps.text: Chop the prawns and mushrooms. Mix with the pork, ginger and soy.
Spoon into the wonton wrappers, pinch up the sides leaving the top open and add a dot of grated carrot.
Steam in batches until cooked through.

note: home turf, a long way from Beverly Hills

steps.text: Finely dice half the onion and the other half for topping.
Brown the mince with the diced onion in oil.
Stir in the chilli powder, cumin and water and simmer gently, adding water if needed to keep it loose.
Heat the franks in a griddle pan until piping hot.
Fill the buns with franks, chilli, mustard and the raw onion.

note: Baby vegetables with a creamy herb and anchovy dip

dish.make_ahead: Dip up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Blitz the mayonnaise, sour cream, herbs, anchovies and lemon juice until green and smooth.
Cut the vegetables into sticks or halves.
Arrange the vegetables on ice around the bowl of dip.

note: Franks on sticks dipped in cornmeal batter and fried

steps.text: Whisk the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, egg and buttermilk into a batter.
Pat the franks dry and push onto sticks.
Heat the oil to 180C.
Dip the franks in batter and fry in batches until deep gold.
Serve with mustard.

note: Beef marinated overnight in soy, Worcestershire and pepper, then dried

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 weeks, in a bag

steps.text: Partly freeze the beef until firm.
Slice very thin.
Mix the marinade and marinate the beef overnight.
Pat dry and lay on racks.
Dry at 70C.
Cool and store in a bag.

note: the inside, after the frame-up

steps.text: Spread the bread with mustard and layer devon and cheese between the slices to make sandwiches.
Butter the outsides.
Griddle under a weighted pan until crisp and the cheese melts, turning once. Work in batches.
Cut into fingers to share.

note: the chase across East LA

steps.text: Marinate the steak in lime juice, crushed garlic and cumin.
Grill hot on both sides.
Rest the steak, then chop small.
Warm the tortillas and dice the onion.
Fill the tortillas with steak, onion, coriander and salsa verde, with lime wedges on the side.

note: Pickled herring with sour cream, dill and red onion on buttered dark rye

steps.text: Drain the herring and cut into bite pieces.
Mix with the sour cream, chopped dill and thinly sliced red onion.
Butter the rye, cut into squares and spoon the herring on top.

note: Pretzels, peanuts, cereal squares and seeds baked with Worcestershire butter

steps.text: Toss the pretzels, peanuts, cereal squares and sunflower seeds with the melted butter, Worcestershire and garlic powder.
Bake at 130C, stirring every 15 minutes.
Cool before bagging up.

note: Fresh oysters on crushed ice with red wine vinegar and shallot

steps.text: Finely dice the shallot and mix with the vinegar and pepper for the mignonette.
Shuck the oysters and lay on crushed ice.
Spoon a little mignonette over each and serve with lemon wedges.

note: the city's Cuban counter snack

dish.make_ahead: Chill overnight, up to 1 day before frying

steps.text: Melt the butter, stir in the flour and cook briefly. Gradually whisk in the milk and cook until a very thick bechamel forms.
Stir in the ham and nutmeg.
Spread in a shallow dish, cool promptly and refrigerate overnight.
Shape into logs.
Dust with flour, dip in beaten egg and coat in breadcrumbs.
Fry in 180C oil until golden and hot throughout. Drain.

note: Carter's order, extra hot

steps.text: Pat the wings dry and season with salt.
Bake on a rack at 220C, turning halfway, until crisp and at least 74C inside.
Mix the sour cream, mayonnaise, chives, garlic powder and lemon juice for the ranch dip.
Melt the butter with the hot sauce and toss through the wings.

note: Crisp fried prawns tossed in a wok with garlic, red chili and spring onion

steps.text: Dry the prawns well, season with salt and white pepper and toss in the potato starch.
Fry in 190C oil in batches until crisp.
In a wok, fry the sliced garlic, chilli and spring onions in a little oil, then add the prawns and toss well.

note: King prawns with garlic, chili and lime, grilled on skewers

steps.text: Soak the skewers. Toss the prawns with crushed garlic, chopped chilli, lime zest and juice, and oil.
Thread onto skewers.
Grill over hot coals on both sides.
Serve with lime wedges.

note: Beer battered white fish in flour tortillas with slaw and chipotle mayo

steps.text: Cut the fish into strips. Whisk the flour, beer and salt into a batter.
Toss the cabbage with lime juice and salt.
Mix the mayonnaise with the chipotle.
Dip the fish in batter and fry in 180C oil until golden, in batches.
Warm the tortillas and fill with slaw, fish, chipotle mayo and coriander.

note: Three colors of layered jelly cut into neat cubes, with a little whipped cream

steps.text: Make each jelly one at a time, adding extra gelatine to the water.
Set each layer in the fridge before adding the next.
Turn out and cut into neat cubes.
Serve on a white plate with a little whipped cream.

film: The Naked Gun: From the Files of Police Squad! (1988)
note: Griddled franks in steamed buns with yellow mustard and sweet relish

steps.text: Simmer the franks, then griddle until blistered.
Steam the buns over the pot.
Load each with a frank, mustard and relish and wrap in paper.

note: Poached prawns served cold with horseradish cocktail sauce

steps.text: Poach the prawns until just pink.
Plunge into iced water, then peel.
Mix the tomato sauce with horseradish, lemon juice and hot sauce.
Serve on shredded iceberg in martini glasses with lemon wedges.

note: Prawns tossed in hot olive oil with garlic, chili and butter

steps.text: Slice the garlic and chilli.
Heat the oil and fry the garlic and chilli briefly.
Toss the prawns over high heat.
Add the butter, wine and parsley. Serve with bread for the juices.

note: Rye squares with smoked salmon, crème fraîche and a garnish of dill

steps.text: Butter the rye and cut into small squares.
Top each with a fold of smoked salmon, a small spoon of creme fraiche, a dill sprig and pepper.

note: Smoked trout and cream cheese spread on rye crackers with pickled red onion

steps.text: Slice the red onion thin and soak in the vinegar with the sugar to pickle.
Flake the trout, removing any skin and bones.
Blitz half the trout with the cream cheese, lemon juice, horseradish and pepper.
Fold in the rest of the trout with chopped dill so it stays chunky.
Spread thick on rye crackers and top with the pickled onion.

note: Roasted pumpkin soup finished with cream and toasted pepitas

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Toss the pumpkin with oil and salt.
Roast until caramelised.
Soften the diced onion and garlic in butter.
Add the pumpkin and stock and simmer.
Blitz until smooth and stir in the cream.
Toast the pepitas in a dry pan.
Pour into a warmed thermos and scatter pepitas on each mug.

note: Brioche rounds topped with fried quail eggs, crisp bacon and chives

steps.text: Cut 12 small rounds from the brioche and toast them.
Fry the bacon until crisp and break into pieces.
Fry the quail eggs in butter.
Put an egg and a bit of bacon on each round and sprinkle with chives.

note: the beat they walk every day

ingredients.item: small poppy seed hot dog buns

steps.text: Dice the onion and slice the tomato.
Heat the franks in simmering water until piping hot.
Warm the buns in a steamer.
Fill the buns and finish with celery salt.

note: the retirement dream down south

steps.text: Finely chop the prawns, capsicum, onion and celery.
Mix the flour, baking powder, egg and milk to a thick batter, then fold in the prawns and vegetables.
Heat the oil to 180C.
Fry spoonfuls until golden, in batches.
Mix the mayonnaise with lime juice and serve.

film: Back to the Future Part II (1989)
note: Blue jelly with gummy sharks, topped with whipped cream waves

steps.text: Dissolve the jelly crystals in the boiling water, then stir in the cold water.
Pour halfway into four glasses and chill until just starting to set.
Push the gummy sharks in, top up with the rest of the jelly and chill until fully set.
Whip the cream to soft peaks and spoon on top as waves.

note: Fried egg rolls filled with pork, cabbage, carrot and spring onion

dish.make_ahead: Rolled and uncooked up to 4 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Fry the pork mince until browned, breaking it up.
Add the cabbage, carrot, spring onions and soy sauce and cook until dry. Cool the filling.
Roll a spoonful into each wrapper, sealing the edge with water.
Heat the oil to about 5cm deep and fry in batches until golden.
Drain on paper towel.

note: Pan fried pork dumplings with a black vinegar and chili oil dip

steps.text: Mix the black vinegar, chilli oil and spring onion for dipping.
Heat the oil in a large non-stick pan and add the dumplings flat side down until golden.
Add the water, cover and steam until the water is gone.
Fry one more minute to re-crisp the bottoms and serve with the dip.

note: Garlic and lime prawn skewers grilled, served on ice with sweet chili sauce

dish.make_ahead: Prawns can marinate up to 2 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Peel the prawns, leaving the tails on.
Toss with the garlic, chilli, zest and juice of one lime and the oil.
Thread onto skewers.
Grill or griddle on high until pink and charred.
Serve on ice with the sweet chilli sauce and wedges of the other lime.

note: Coconut milk jelly under blue flower jelly that turns purple with lemon

dish.make_ahead: Make the day before, lemon at the table

steps.text: Soften two gelatine leaves in cold water. Warm the coconut milk with some of the sugar and stir in the squeezed gelatine.
Pour into four glasses and chill until set.
Steep the butterfly pea flowers in the boiling water, strain and stir in the remaining sugar and two softened gelatine leaves.
Cool, then pour gently over the set coconut layer and chill until set.
At the table, squeeze lemon over the top and watch it turn purple.

note: Baked pastry turnovers filled with spiced beef, egg and olives

dish.make_ahead: Filled and uncooked up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Boil two of the eggs until hard, then cool, peel and chop.
Fry the mince and onion with the cumin and paprika until browned.
Stir in the chopped eggs and olives and cool the filling.
Cut the pastry into 12 rounds, fill, fold and crimp the edges.
Brush with the remaining beaten egg. Bake at 200C until golden.

note: pale, wobbly and unsettling

steps.text: Soak the gelatine leaves in cold water and lightly oil four small round moulds.
Warm the cream, milk, sugar and vanilla seeds until steaming, without boiling.
Squeeze the gelatine dry and stir in until dissolved, then divide between the moulds.
Refrigerate until set.
Dip each mould briefly in warm water, turn out and fan the orange peel around as legs.

note: Seeded crackers with lemon cream cheese and a smoked oyster on each

steps.text: Whip the cream cheese with the lemon zest.
Spread onto the crackers.
Top each with a smoked oyster, cracked pepper and snipped chives. Serve straight away.

note: Smoked salmon and dill on rye, plus cucumber cups filled with whipped feta

steps.text: Butter the rye, cut into squares and top with creme fraiche, smoked salmon and dill.
Cut the cucumbers into thick rounds and scoop a small hollow in each.
Whip the feta with the olive oil until smooth and fill the cucumber cups.
Arrange on a platter.

note: Pan fried pork and cabbage gyoza with a soy and chili oil dip

dish.make_ahead: Fill and pleat up to 4 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Salt the cabbage, let it sit, then squeeze dry.
Mix with the pork, soy and ginger.
Fill the wrappers and pleat the edges.
Fry in oil until crisp underneath, then add water and steam with a lid.
Mix soy, rice vinegar and chilli oil for dipping.

note: Cereal, pretzel and peanut mix baked in honey butter, with mini marshmallows

steps.text: Heat the oven to 140C. Melt the butter with the honey.
Toss the cereal, pretzels and peanuts with the honey butter.
Bake, stirring once.
Cool completely, then toss through the marshmallows.

note: Beef marinated overnight in soy, brown sugar and pepper, dried low and slow

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 weeks, airtight in the fridge

steps.text: Slice the beef thin across the grain.
Marinate with the soy, sugar and pepper overnight in the fridge.
Lay on racks and dry in a low oven with the door ajar until leathery but bendy.

note: Mixed nuts and pretzels baked in garlic, smoked paprika and Worcestershire butter

dish.n: Fan expo smoky garlic nut mix

steps.text: Heat the oven to 140C. Melt the butter with the Worcestershire, garlic powder, paprika and salt.
Toss with the nuts and pretzels until coated and spread on a lined tray.
Bake, stirring twice, until toasted and dry.
Cool and serve in paper cups.

note: Black olive, caper and anchovy tapenade with jagged seeded cracker shards

dish.make_ahead: Tapenade up to 3 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Pulse the olives, capers, anchovies, garlic, lemon juice and oil until coarse.
Break the crackers into jagged shards.
Serve the tapenade with the cracker shards.

note: Seared rump cubes tossed in garlic butter, with a peppercorn sour cream dip

steps.text: Cut the rump into cubes and season well.
Mix the sour cream with the cracked pepper for the dip.
Sear the steak hard in a smoking pan in batches.
Toss with the butter and garlic. Serve on toothpicks with the dip.

note: Beef marinated overnight in soy and Worcestershire, dried low and slow

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 weeks, airtight in the fridge

steps.text: Slice the beef thin across the grain.
Marinate with the soy, Worcestershire, sugar and pepper overnight in the fridge.
Dry on racks in a low oven with the door ajar until leathery.

note: Pork crackling with chili salt, plus honey cayenne roasted peanuts

dish.n: Chang's Market spiced nuts and crackling

steps.text: Score the pork rind finely, rub with salt and leave uncovered in the fridge.
Pat dry and roast at 230C until blistered and crisp. Break into pieces and toss with chilli salt.
Toss the peanuts with the honey, cayenne, salt and oil.
Roast at 180C, stirring once.

note: Marshmallow puffed rice treat pressed in a ring mold, cut into wedges

steps.text: Melt the butter with the marshmallows over low heat.
Stir through the puffed rice until coated.
Press firmly into a greased ring mould.
Set, then turn out and cut into wedges at the table.

note: Toasted marshmallow and milk chocolate squashed between plain cookies

steps.text: Toast the marshmallows on skewers over a gas flame or under the grill until golden.
Squash each between two biscuits with a square of chocolate.
Leave briefly so the chocolate melts.

note: Brined roast turkey drumsticks glazed with honey and wholegrain mustard

steps.text: Dissolve the salt and sugar in the water and brine the drumsticks overnight in the fridge.
Pat the drumsticks dry.
Roast at 160C for most of the cooking time.
Mix the honey and mustard, brush over and roast until glazed.

film: Close Encounters of the Third Kind (1977)
note: Seeded crackers topped five ways: cream cheese, pâté, cheddar, salmon, fig

dish.make_ahead: Assemble just before serving so the crackers stay crisp

steps.text: Lay the crackers out in rows of five.
Top each row with a different note: cream cheese, pate, cheddar, smoked salmon with dill, and fig.
Serve straight away.
